title: Diving in Tanzania: Zanzibar, Pemba and Mafia
excerpt: From Mnemba to the Pemba Channel and Mafia's marine park: the best places for diving in Tanzania.
body:
## Zanzibar

- [Mnemba Atoll](/blog/mnemba-atoll-snorkelling/): good for beginners.
- Reefs off Nungwi.

## Pemba

Walls, currents and healthy coral. See [Pemba](/blog/pemba-island-guide/).

## Mafia

Mafia Island Marine Park and seasonal whale sharks. See [Mafia](/blog/mafia-island-whale-sharks/).

## When

Conditions vary; generally good outside the long rains.

## Certification

Courses are available on Zanzibar.

## Safety

Do not fly within 18–24 hours after diving.

[Plan your diving trip](/travel-proposal/).
